candidates.description: A scale used to assess the functional status of cancer patients, ranging from fully active to significantly disabled.
candidates.extraction_instruction: Identify the numeric value associated with 'ECOG' or 'performance status' in the oncology progress notes.
candidates.measurement_definition: Standard Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) scale; evidence includes 0 (fully active), 1 (ambulatory, capable of self-care), and 2 (capable of self-care but unable to work).
candidates.name: ECOG Performance Status
candidates.uncertainty: The specific threshold between ECOG 1 and 2 may be subject to provider interpretation across different notes.

candidates.description: The Tumor Proportion Score (TPS) for Programmed Death-Ligand 1 (PD-L1), representing the percentage of tumor cells with membrane staining.
candidates.extraction_instruction: Locate 'PD-L1 TPS' and extract the numerical percentage value from the molecular profile or pathology report.
candidates.measurement_definition: Percentage (%) of PD-L1 positive tumor cells.
candidates.name: PD-L1 TPS
candidates.uncertainty: The specific IHC assay used for PD-L1 measurement is not specified in the provided evidence.

limitations: Small sample size of patients in the provided evidence.
Molecular profiling (PD-L1) is not documented for all patients.
ECOG status is recorded at multiple timepoints, which may introduce temporal variance.
summary: The evidence supports the identification of baseline clinical variables for patients with stage IV squamous non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) and brain metastases, specifically functional performance status (ECOG) and PD-L1 expression levels.
